# Swahili and English Terms

:::cdi-message
- **ID:** JIO-R01
- **Type:** Resource
- **Audience:** Learners
- **Theme:** Language, Vocabulary
:::

## Learning New Words

Learning technology and communication sometimes introduces new words.

Understanding common terms helps make learning easier.

::: {.callout-note}
Do not worry if you do not know every word immediately.

New words become familiar through practice.
:::

## Computer and Learning Terms

| English | Swahili |
|---|---|
| Computer | Kompyuta |
| Keyboard | Kibodi |
| Mouse | Kipanya |
| Screen | Skrini |
| Folder | Folda |
| File | Faili |
| Document | Hati |
| Picture | Picha |
| Password | Nenosiri |
| Internet | Intaneti |
| Printer | Printa |
| Project | Mradi |
| Learning | Kujifunza |
| Community | Jamii |
| Opportunity | Fursa |

## Communication Terms

| English | Swahili |
|---|---|
| Flyer | Tangazo |
| Message | Ujumbe |
| Information | Taarifa |
| Meeting | Mkutano |
| Event | Tukio |
| Contact | Mawasiliano |
| Support | Msaada |
| Design | Ubunifu |
| Share | Kushiriki |
| Create | Kuunda |

## Reflection

Think about these questions:

1. Which words were already familiar?

2. Which words were new?

3. Which words would I like to remember?
